def pack(legend,bg,template,hole):
 objs=extract_objects(legend,bg);R,C=len(template),len(template[0]);placements=[]
 for i,p in enumerate(objs):
  h,w=len(p),len(p[0])

   for b in range(C-w+1):
    cells=[(a+r,b+c,p[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if p[r][c]!=bg]
    hit=sum(template[x][y]==hole for x,y,v in cells)
    placements.append((i,a,b,cells,hit,len(cells)))
 n=len(placements); cons=len(objs)+R*C
 A=lil_matrix((cons,n),dtype=float)
 for j,(i,a,b,cells,hit,area) in enumerate(placements):
  A[i,j]=1
  for x,y,v in cells:A[len(objs)+x*C+y,j]=1
 lb=np.r_[np.ones(len(objs)),np.zeros(R*C)]
 ub=np.r_[np.ones(len(objs)),np.ones(R*C)]
 # maximize hit strongly and penalize painted background weakly
 costs=np.array([-3*hit+(area-hit) for i,a,b,cells,hit,area in placements],float)
